newsitem.title: ITALY: Full Italy quarterly accounts ready Thurs - Minister.
newsitem.headline: Full Italy quarterly accounts ready Thurs - Minister.

text.p: Full details of Italy's quarterly accounts will be ready next Thursday, Industry Minister Claudio Burlando told reporters on Friday.
"The size of the mini-budget will be decided by the cabinet on the basis of these definitive figures," Burlando told reporters after a cabinet meeting.

Following the meeting, the cabinet office issued a statement saying the forthcoming mini-budget would include deficit-cutting measures of "around" 15.5 trillion lire. The package is expected to be unveiled before the end of the month.
The broad outline of the eagerly awaited quarterly accounts are expected to be released within the next two days.
